model.subtitle: Performance metrics, decision factors, and validation statistics for the active retention model
model.accuracyDesc: Percentage of all churn and retention predictions that were correct.
model.precisionDesc: Of all customers predicted to churn, percentage that actually churned.
model.recallDesc: Of all customers who actually churned, percentage successfully caught by the model.

model.rocAucDesc: Overall ability of the model to distinguish between churning and staying customers across all thresholds.

model.thresholdMedDesc: Early warning signs detected. Candidate for targeted soft perks.
model.thresholdHighDesc: High probability of departure. Requires proactive retention offer.
model.factorsDesc: Global feature weights learned by the logistic regression classifier.
